Avec la revalorisation du smic, le gouvernement espère un effet d'entraînement sur les négociations salariales dans les branches professionnelles et au sein des entreprises. items.title: Social unrest ahead of French elections:  Protesters 'don't believe politics can achieve anything'

France's 1.6% minimum-wage increase, in response to the countrywide protests, may offer a temporary reprieve from social unrest, but it does little to resolve the deeper political and institutional crisis confronting the country. According to Foucart, the central problem extends beyond declining purchasing power, fiscal constraints and the limitations of a minority government. Farmers face big drop in production from extreme weather during this year’s super El Niño event
